'''Pon Rooshan''' was an inscrutable [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] individual who served as the leader of the [[Rooshan]] clan on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. She hired an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] to pretend to try to kill [[Emen Rooshan]], which she planned to use to cause war with the rival [[Ku'rys]] clan.<ref name="GatORW" />
